moral_character_required.quote: Each member of the board shall be at least twenty-five (25) years of age and of good moral character.

required.quote: Anyone desiring to be licensed as a contractor in this state shall take a written examination to determine the applicant's qualifications.

exams.name: Contractor written examination
exams.notes: Board may administer orally if written exam is precluded by disability. For limited licensed electricians, board may administer or contract for administration.
exams.quote: Anyone desiring to be licensed as a contractor in this state shall take a written examination to determine the applicant's qualifications.

exams.name: Limited licensed electrician examination
exams.notes: Required for limited licensed electricians (electrical work under $25,000); board may administer or contract for administration. Certain grandfathered applicants (registered before Sept 1, 2000) could obtain license without exam by application before July 1, 2001.
exams.quote: To receive a license, the applicant shall pay a fee as set by the board for the license and shall pass an examination prescribed by the board. The board may administer the examination or may contract for the administration of the examination.

interval_years.quote: A certificate of license expires on the last day of the twenty-fourth month following its issuance or renewal and becomes invalid on that date unless renewed.

required.quote: Licensed contractors in the category set forth under subdivision (a)(9), licensed on or after January 1, 2009, must complete continuing education, a minimum of eight (8) hours biennially, by a board-approved provider.

available.quote: anyone desiring to be licensed as a contractor for this state who resides in a state that does not practice reciprocity with licensees of the Tennessee board for licensing contractors shall make written application on forms prescribed by the board

requirements.value: Reciprocity is available with states that practice reciprocity with Tennessee. Applicants from non-reciprocity states must apply separately. For limited licensed electricians, exam is still required in counties/municipalities that issued their own licenses.

exists.quote: There is created a state board for licensing contractors, called the "board" in this part, to be appointed by the governor. The board shall be composed of nine (9) members, all of whom shall be residents of this state and at least three (3) of whom shall be actively engaged as residential contractors ... at least one (1) of whom shall be actively engaged as an electrical contractor

regulatory_model.quote: It is unlawful for any person, firm, or corporation to engage in or offer to engage in contracting for any project in this state, unless, at the time of such engagement or offer to engage, the person, firm, or corporation has been duly licensed

credential_type.quote: if the results of the examination of any applicant are satisfactory to the board, then it shall issue to the applicant a certificate authorizing the applicant to operate as a contractor in this state

is_mandatory.quote: It is unlawful for any person, firm, or corporation to engage in or offer to engage in contracting for any project in this state, unless, at the time of such engagement or offer to engage, the person, firm, or corporation has been duly licensed

title_protection.quote: It is unlawful for any person, firm or corporation to represent itself as a licensed contractor or to act in the capacity of a "contractor" as defined in §§ 62-6-102 ... while not licensed

scope_protection.quote: Any person, firm or corporation that engages or offers to engage in contracting without a license as required by § 62-6-103 ... commits a Class A misdemeanor.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross negligence or incompetency in the practice of contracting
disciplinary_grounds.quote: damaged or injured by the gross negligence, incompetency, fraud, dishonest dealing or misconduct in the practice of contracting

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or dishonest dealing in contracting
disciplinary_grounds.quote: gross negligence, incompetency, fraud, dishonest dealing or misconduct in the practice of contracting

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction for violation of § 39-14-154 (home improvement fraud)
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The board shall revoke the license of any contractor, home improvement contractor or home improvement services provider upon receiving notification from the court in accordance with § 39-14-154(d) of such person's conviction for a violation of § 39-14-154.
The board may refuse to issue or renew a license to any person, firm or corporation for lack of financial stability
lack of expertise, submission of false evidence with regard to application of license or renewal, conviction of a felony

disciplinary_grounds.description: Submission of false evidence in license or renewal application
disciplinary_grounds.quote: submission of false evidence with regard to application of license or renewal
conviction of a felony and any other conduct that constitutes improper, fraudulent or dishonest dealing or violation of the statute

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any conduct constituting improper, fraudulent or dishonest dealing
disciplinary_grounds.quote: any other conduct that constitutes improper, fraudulent or dishonest dealing or violation of the statute

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to observe terms and conditions of any license or renewal, or violation of bylaws, rules or regulations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: for a failure to observe the terms and conditions of any license or renewal granted under this part or any bylaws, rules or regulations adopted or promulgated by it

disciplinary_grounds.description: Faulty electrical work performed by a limited licensed electrician
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The board for licensing contractors may revoke or suspend the license of a limited licensed electrician for faulty electrical work performed by the licensee.

bonding_required.quote: it shall be the duty of every person who makes contracts described in subdivisions (a)(1)-(4) ... to register with the department of codes administration or other appropriate departments and to post a permit bond in the amount set forth in this section

insurance_required.quote: The application shall also be accompanied by evidence of the applicant's current workers' compensation insurance coverage. Failure to provide evidence of insurance coverage shall make the applicant ineligible for licensure

definition_quote.value: "Electrical construction" is one of the nine major construction classifications; "Limited licensed electrician" means any person or entity that performs any electrical work that has a total cost of less than twenty-five thousand dollars ($25,000) and that is required to be registered under § 68-102-150
definition_quote.quote: "Limited licensed electrician" means any person or entity that performs any electrical work that has a total cost of less than twenty-five thousand dollars ($25,000) and that is required to be registered under § 68-102-150

license_tiers.quote: "Limited licensed electrician" means any person or entity that performs any electrical work that has a total cost of less than twenty-five thousand dollars ($25,000) ... "Contractor" includes, but is not limited to, a prime contractor, electrical contractor, electrical subcontractor

value: Homeowner performing electrical work on their own single residence
Electrical work in a municipality or county that issues its own licenses to persons performing electrical work

scope_exclusions.quote: any single residence homeowner is exempt from the limited licensed electrician requirements of this part for purposes of performing electrical work on the homeowner's own residence

qualifier_required.quote: Corporations and partnerships may engage in the business of contracting; provided, that at least one (1) of the major stockholders or partners or full-time employees with a written power of attorney to bind the corporation or partnership has sufficient knowledge of the construction business in which the persons are licensed to perform.

qualifier_replacement_grace_period_days.quote: If the person who took the examination for the partnership or corporation leaves the firm for any reason, the partnership or corporation must designate an individual to take the examination within three (3) months.

small_project_dollar_threshold_exemption.quote: "Contractor" means any person or entity that undertakes to, attempts to or submits a price or bid or offers to construct ... for which the total cost is twenty-five thousand dollars ($25,000) or more

workers_compensation_insurance_required.quote: The application shall also be accompanied by evidence of the applicant's current workers' compensation insurance coverage. Failure to provide evidence of insurance coverage shall make the applicant ineligible for licensure by the board until evidence of insurance coverage is provided.

public_liability_insurance_required.quote: Any application for initial licensure or for renewal of licensure also shall be accompanied by an affidavit affirming that the applicant maintains general liability insurance and workers' compensation insurance
